designDecisionsAndRationale: One engine core under src/dsp/ugen/fm/ with two entry points (fm-mod algorithm mode and new fm6-core) so the existing FM synth is extended instead of a parallel engine.

Backward compatibility: fm-mod gains appended implicit ports named after existing control rows (algorithm 21, freq 0, ratio 19, velocity 6); the golden graph digest hashes only def.nodes Debug and edge triples, so it is unchanged; row 21 and the fm header default become 0 and algorithm <= 0 or non-finite takes the byte-identical legacy modulate branch.
Production algorithm table is authored from the published chart and proven equal to a derivation from msfa's bus-flag bytes embedded only in the test fixture; msfa wins on disagreement.
fm6-core carries an optional 155-value constant patch: payload following the frame-keyframe-core frames: precedent (codec tag 105, max 4 payloads).
fm6-sysex reads bytes on the evaluator thread through a new SourceLoader::read_bytes (native only, 64 KiB cap); parse never runs on the audio thread.
Hurdy-gurdy uses a new bowed digital waveguide with a hyperbolic friction curve because the existing Elements bow cannot produce Helmholtz motion.
Tonewheel organ and hurdy-gurdy own note length through gate-length with cps delivered by wants_tempo_anchor, following bass-core.
intentionalTradeoffs: FM output is normalized by carrier count and uses analytic sine and f32 math; behaviour matches msfa within stated tolerances, not bit for bit.
fm algorithm mode uses a macro operator set; full patches are only available through fm6-core.
Single-trigger percussion is an explicit per-event control decided at voice start (FV5).
Hurdy-gurdy drones are per voice (FV4); the buzz bridge is a one-sided impact model with no thermal friction.
GENDYN locks pitch at gendyn-spread 0; scanned uses a fixed 64-mass ring with a circular scan path.
A user inst declaring a non-zero algorithm now selects a topology (FV2); the design-music.md epiano sketch is changed to algorithm: int = 0.
supportedEdgeCases: algorithm 0, negative or NaN takes the legacy branch bit-identically; 1..=32 select topologies; algorithm latched per voice.
SysEx device nibble ignored; truncated headers report Length; out-of-range fields clamp without error; validation order Empty..MissingEnd stops at the first failure.
Sample rates 44.1, 48 and 96 kHz and 64/97/128/256-frame blocks render block-size independently.
Control extremes for every kernel stay finite with |y| <= 1; scanned stability inequality 4k + c < 4 - 2d - 0.1 at every control corner.
Native vs browser codec parity for the six voices and fm6-core with and without patch.
outOfScopeEdgeCases: Browser-hosted SysEx loading and song-mode loaders (host-unavailable).
Patch-name display, LFO/pitch-EG/AMS/PMS behaviour from SysEx files.
Cross-voice shared hurdy-gurdy drones, tonewheel leakage/crosstalk.
